Answers provided by [[[button:@UnknownSuperficialNight][_developers/UnknownSuperficialNight]]], the developer.
RhythmiRust started as 2 bash scripts: one for downloading, one for searching.
Of course, this became hard to manage and use, so I decided that I should probably combine them
into a single application that also works cross-platform.
Thus RhythmiRust was born.
I wanted to make a [[[strong:music player]]] due to the lack of one that offered a search feature, let alone a downloader.
My primary aim was to make an effortless method for downloading/syncing videos from platforms like YouTube, Spotify, and SoundCloud;
these downloaded files would then be stored locally for preservation and playback.
RhythmiRust is intended to be an efficient, portable, feature-rich and lightweight application.
This means minimal CPU and RAM usage, and a fully portable cross-platform configuration
with album art support and metadata editing.
However, it also aims to be feature-rich, so it will sacrifice a small amount of memory for a wide range of extra features.
I intend to keep real memory usage ideally below [[[strong:300 MB]]] of RAM, which is about the same as VLC uses on Linux.

contents.Header2: The Influence of Music on RhythmiRust's Development

contents.Text: As a music enthusiast with a vast collection of [[[strong:28,887 songs]]] (as of [[[strong:28 October 2026]]]),
I desired an easy method to [[[strong:search through]]] and [[[strong:play]]] them, and to [[[strong:download/sync]]] new additions.

contents.Header2: The Core Values Guiding the Development of RhythmiRust

contents.Text: •[[[strong:Convenience:]]] RhythmiRust should suit [[[strong:technical users]]] and [[[strong:everyday users]]] at the same time.
Technical users should be able to do more advanced things, while the basics stay simple enough for anyone to understand and just use.
•[[[strong:Everything inside the GUI:]]] No elements should appear outside of the GUI (such as opening a system file dialogue).
•[[[strong:Self-contained:]]] The application should require minimal external dependencies.
RhythmiRust has up to [[[strong:four external dependencies]]].
RhythmiRust [[[strong:manages them itself]]], automatically [[[strong:updating them]]] and keeping them correct, so you do not need to install anything manually.
If you already have some of them installed, RhythmiRust will [[[strong:use the ones from your system]]] instead.
